newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Feb 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- Britain granted full citizenship to Hong Kong's ethnic minorities who would have been left stateless after the handover on June 30.

-- HONG KONG STANDARD -- British Foreign Minister Malcolm Rifkind said he would invite his Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen to agree to a proposal that the International Court of Justice probe the legality of the Provisional Legislature.
-- APPLE DAILY -- China Light & Power Co Ltd announced an average 5.9 percent increase in electricity charges from March 1 -- its third in a year.

-- WEN WEI PO -- Chief Executive-designate Tung Chee-hwa said Britain should hand over Hong Kong government files to China, which would then transfer them to the post-handover Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government.

-- TA KUNG PAO -- Chinese President Jiang Zemin, Premier Li Peng and other party dignitaries paid a visit to paramount leader Deng Xiaoping and other senior officials ahead of the Chinese New Year. There was no reference to the state of Deng's health.
